semantics.sign: A directly observed Wallet authorization or device-proof signing flow; package signing alone does not qualify.
semantics.tx: A directly observed YNX Testnet transaction with authoritative receipt evidence.
semantics.callback: An application-level callback delivered and handled; parser-only tests or an OS confirmation sheet do not qualify.
semantics.reconnect: A directly observed reconnection after transport or process interruption; second launch alone does not qualify.
semantics.downloadHosted: An immutable public product download verified end to end; local files and temporary CI artifacts do not qualify.
semantics.productionSigned: A production distribution identity, never a test, disposable, unsigned, unpacked, simulator or ad-hoc identity.
semantics.storeReleased: A directly verified public store listing for the exact artifact and source commit.
